page: Microsoft Azure EC48eds_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEDV6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and features 48 dedicated vCPUs running on an Intel processor under the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, providing a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core.

This server type includes 2835 GB of local storage and is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There are no onboard GPUs, making it a CPU-only compute node.

From a cost efficiency perspective, the EC48eds_v6 offers high memory density per vCPU, which is advantageous for workloads requiring large in-memory datasets without the overhead of paying for excess compute cores. However, the lack of dedicated GPU hardware limits its utility for accelerated machine learning or graphics rendering tasks.

The hardware configuration is designed for memory-intensive applications, large relational databases, in-memory caching systems, and enterprise applications that require substantial local storage capacity alongside high memory-to-CPU ratios.
